researchIterations.summary: Main thread verified official inventory and GPX/API baseline. HÖ21 GPX has 597 trackpoints, one segment, 16.324923 km, start 57.53290/14.13979, end 57.42848/14.06858, four gaps over 100 m, none over 150 m, no duplicate coordinate values, HÖ20-HÖ21 gap 1.194 m, HÖ21-HÖ22 gap 6.053 m and direct GPX available while .kml/.geojson/.json variants were unavailable.

importReadiness.summary: HÖ21 has navigation-grade official GPX/API v2 geometry, strong endpoint continuity with HÖ20 and HÖ22, high-confidence shared endpoints at Byarum and Grönelund, usable transit/access research, coordinate-backed endpoint shelter/service records and sufficient six-lane coverage. Main caveats are Grönelund versus Skillingaryd endpoint modeling, station connector length conflict, Byarum connector naming/topology, Byarum water/cafe seasonality, Norra Duveled/Gärahovs rule scoping, off-route Hjortsjön/Götaström/Skillingaryd service threshold, dynamic fire-ban status, Storm Dave windthrow currentness and nearby military-range notices.
importReadiness.appDescriptionDraft: From Byarum, HÖ21 follows the west branch of Höglandsleden through forest and open cultural landscape near Södra Duveled before turning toward Grönelunds friluftsområde west of Skillingaryd. The Byarum end has limited parking, bus access via the church connector and seasonal hembygdsgård services, while the Grönelund end has parking, shelter and fireplace context plus an official unmarked connector to Skillingaryd station. Use the official GPX as the route source, keep Byarum/Skillingaryd connectors separate, and verify fire-ban, windthrow, military-area notices and seasonal service status before publication.
importReadiness.recommendedNextStep: Continue Höglandsleden research with HÖ22 Skillingaryd-Asafors. Do not normalize or import runtime data until the full research phase is reviewed and import is explicitly requested.
